guide.n: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute
rewards: Access to a new Hardwood Farming Patch

st.t: Talk to Marcellus near the Locus Oasis south of Civitas illa Fortis. AJP Fairy ring is fastest.
Talk to the blue frogs in the north-east of the oasis.
Return to the blue frogs Sue and Gary in the north-east of the oasis.
Talk to the yellow frogs Jane and Dave to the south of Gary.
Chop down the orange tree next to the yellow frogs. If you have no axe, take the bronze axe from the logs next to Marcellus.
Sabotage the lily pad near to the yellow frogs.
Return to Sue and Gary in the north-east of the oasis.
Go talk to Sue and Gary to discuss framing the flies.
Search the chest in the building next to Marcellus and enter the code NALIA.
Plant the plushy in the capybara dung east of Marcellus, south of the orange tree.
If Cuthbert doesn't appear when you plant the plushy, inspect the dung east of Marcellus, south of the orange tree.
Talk to Sue and Gary to resolve the dispute!
